subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Which of the following pair is not correctly matched? 
 
{Input is x[n] and output is y[n]} 
 
(a) Linear system: y[n] = x [n2] 
 
(b) Time-invariant system: y[n] = x2 [n – 1] 
 
(c) Causal system: y[n] = x[n] + n 
 
(d) Static system: y[n] = x[3n]
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-07 (Types of System).
